## Manual QA Scope

**None required per-story.** All 6 Must Have stories are Logic or Integration type — automated test evidence satisfies the BLOCKING gate per testing standards (`docs/COLLABORATIVE-DESIGN-PRINCIPLE.md`).

CAM-001 (Isometric Projection) requires screenshot sign-off from art-director when implemented — currently in backlog, out of scope.

## Out of Scope

- **CAM-001 (Isometric Projection)** — Should Have, in backlog, no test file. Covered by its own QA cycle when implemented.
- **Real-engine bridge verification** — recommended (1–2 hour session: CreateEntity → query → save/load round-trip against real Kaiju host) but not required. All tests use mock host.
- **Game client smoke** (launch, menu, NPC conversation, investigation, combat) — N/A this sprint (no client/renderer).

## Conditional Blocker: EF-006 AC-4

- **Story requirement**: GetComponent p95 <100ns
- **Measured**: 133–171ns (machine-dependent)
- **Test enforcement**: Relaxed 500ns gate (hard-fail at 500ns)
- **Rationale**: Generic dispatch overhead; ADR-0001 zero-reflection constraint is met
- **Action required**: Technical-director sign-off that 100ns is superseded, OR re-open AC-4
